heroSubtitle: Ask us anything about your bookings, payments or Pass.
bookingSub: Pick the booking you need help with

how.a: Pick the services and how many minutes you need. One trained professional comes over and works through them in order. You pay before the visit is confirmed.

included.q: What is included in a visit?
included.a: Any of the tasks you booked, within the booked time. Cooking, deep cleaning, heavy lifting and electrical or plumbing work are not included.

price.a: The cart always shows the final price from our server, including taxes and any Pass, coupon or wallet savings. What you see before paying is what you pay.

pass.a: The Pass gives you discounted visits for a fixed period. It is applied automatically when you book — you don't need to do anything at checkout.

money.a: A wallet in the app. Add money once and pay for bookings in one tap. Top-ups of ₹250 or more get extra reward balance.

cancel.q: Can I cancel or reschedule a booking?
cancel.a: Choose Help with a booking above, pick the booking and chat with us — we'll help you change or cancel it.

failed.q: My payment failed but money was deducted
failed.a: Don't worry — you are never charged twice. The booking is either confirmed automatically or the amount is refunded to your original payment method.
